clue.text: Recreational activity seeing fish coming on to boat

boarding is getting on to a ship or boat

explanation.surface: A fisherman finds amusement watching a fish land on the deck as it is hauled aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding a wheeled plank is a pastime done for fun, so it is a leisure pursuit.

clue.text: Blade composed of three metals?

parts.note: the chemical symbol of potassium, the first of the three metals
the chemical symbol of nickel, the second of the three metals
the chemical symbol of iron, the third of the three metals

explanation.surface: A sword or cutter forged from an alloy of three metals.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the trick: the metals are given by their chemical symbols, K (potassium), Ni (nickel) and Fe (iron), not by what a blade is really made of.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutting implement with a sharpened edge is commonly called a blade.

clue.text: Without hesitation, finds where supporters stand

explanation.definitionFit: Football grounds traditionally had stepped standing areas for fans, known by this name.

clue.text: Way of describing crater? Rocky, say

Rocky Balboa is the prizefighter of the Rocky films

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about how to describe a pit, followed by a film hero.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who packs goods in crates is jokingly one who boxes them, and Rocky is a fictional pugilist.

clue.text: Gate with rails rebuilt in the country

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together again in a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A farm gate and its rails are reconstructed out in the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: This rare adjective means rural, relating to fields and the countryside.

clue.text: Handy being able to accommodate each loss

parts.note: handy means skilful, adroit

explanation.surface: Being practical helps when every setback has to be absorbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Losing a match or battle is suffering a reverse; the noun names that outcome.

clue.text: Historic game, one of two halves of course

definitions.meaning: an old game in which players bowled or rolled balls at a board with numbered holes

definitions.text: one of two halves of course
definitions.meaning: a full golf course of eighteen is split into a front and back half

explanation.surface: An old sport is described as one half of a two-part event.
explanation.definitionFit: The old bowling game shares its name with the half-round of golf, the front or back stretch of a full course.

clue.text: Insect — an insect I shooed from part of roof

parts.note: a bee is a honey-making insect

indicators.note: shooed away from means sent out of, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a tile is one of the pieces covering a roof

explanation.definitionFit: A hard-winged creature of the order Coleoptera, such as a ladybird or weevil.

clue.text: Vehicle going uphill running into animal in European city

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle

clue.text: Newspaper worker recalled time with farceur

explanation.walkthrough: Brian Rix was a British actor-manager known for Whitehall farces.

clue.text: One works to improve official popular with the Queen

clue.text: Reference authors use freely, nothing less

less signals that a letter is taken away from the mixed letters

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.walkthrough: 'freely' rearranges AUTHORS USE, and 'less' takes out the O for 'nothing'.

clue.text: A medic coming round hospital when required

parts.note: doc is short for doctor

clue.text: Be calm, taking time at work as representative

clue.text: Welfare advocate: "Support should be around the day before"

eve is the day before an event

clue.text: Soldier, one getting over swallowing ancient appetiser

explanation.walkthrough: 'Soldier' is a soldier ant, not a military rank.

clue.text: Evidence of health good when encountering depression

parts.note: a low is a depression, emotional or meteorological

clue.text: Second Avenue bar

explanation.surface: A New York address of a drinking place on Second Avenue.

clue.text: A big bed's required to hold son, no expense spared

clue.text: Ice ball about to become solid? On the contrary
